title: Postgres connection failure
symptoms: 应用健康检查失败，数据库不可连接
tool_evidence: check_db_connection: postgres container or TCP probe failed
check_app_health: health endpoint reports database unavailable
root_cause: PostgreSQL 容器停止或连接不可用，导致应用无法连接数据库。

title: Application process down
tool_evidence: check_app_process: app container or process is not running
root_cause: 应用容器或 FastAPI 进程停止，入口健康检查不可用。

verification.expected_result: nginx and direct app health endpoints return HTTP 2xx

title: Redis cache down
tool_evidence: check_app_redis_connection: redis container or TCP probe failed
root_cause: Redis 容器停止或缓存端口不可达，导致 /cache/ping 失败。

verification.expected_result: cache ping and health endpoints return HTTP 2xx

title: Nginx bad route
symptoms: 入口健康检查失败但直连应用正常
tool_evidence: check_network_http_route: direct app health is ok but nginx route failed
root_cause: Nginx 路由配置错误，入口转发到错误 upstream 或路径。

verification.expected_result: nginx entry and direct app health endpoints are both healthy

title: Orders pending slow query
root_cause: orders(status, created_at desc) 索引缺失，导致 pending orders 查询变慢。

successful_repair_action.command: docker exec srebench-postgres psql -U labuser -d labdb -c "create index if not exists idx_orders_status_created_at on orders (status, created_at desc);"

verification.expected_result: orders pending endpoint returns quickly with HTTP 2xx

root_cause: PostgreSQL 数据库容器已异常退出（状态为 exited），导致数据库服务不可用。该故障直接引发底层 TCP 端口拒绝连接，并触发 Docker 内部 DNS 服务发现机制失效，致使应用层无法解析数据库主机名 'postgres' 并建立连接，最终导致数据查询服务完全中断。
possible_causes: PostgreSQL 容器因资源限制（如 OOM）、配置错误或健康检查机制触发而意外退出
数据库进程崩溃或启动参数异常导致服务未能正常拉起
Docker 内部 DNS 缓存未同步或网络插件异常加剧了服务名解析失败
手动停止服务、维护操作或编排策略（如重启失败）导致容器未恢复
